items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I did, just with her, 'If I Had a Ribbon Bow.'

ctx.x: But was she a jazz musician because I think you would say of Corky Hale that she is actually --

Well, she was not considered a jazz musician, she was a studio musician that probably just played the arrangements, whatever they put in front of her. But on this particular show we did -- I did, just with her, 'If I Had a Ribbon Bow.'
